lines.speaker: Louis
lines.text: Shh! Act natural. Keep walking or pretend you're inspecting the floorboards.

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: Why? Are you hiding from someone?

lines.speaker: Louis
lines.text: I'm hiding from everyone. Teachers, club recruiters, anyone holding a clipboard.

lines.speaker: Louis
lines.text: The bleachers here are the only neutral zone in this entire school.

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: *Glances up at the massive ceiling fan wobbling lazily overhead.*

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: Isn't that giant fan right above you making an alarming grinding sound?

lines.speaker: Louis
lines.text: That rattling means it's working. Now keep your voice down, or a faculty member will spot us and make us carry foldable chairs.

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: Fair point. I was never here.
